mapper.sql: c.id, c.type, c.title, c.author_user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.source_user_id, u.location, c.cover_url, c.source_url, coalesce(c.publish_time, 0) as publish_time, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.favorite_count, s.share_count
from content_items c join users u on u.id = c.author_user_id join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id
mapper.select:
select
where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' order by c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc

select
where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' order by c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select
where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.type = 'video' order by c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select , ( case when position(#{query} in lower(c.title)) > 0 then 40 else 0 end + case when position(#{query} in lower(u.nickname)) > 0 then 20 else 0 end + case when exists ( select 1 from content_tags search_tag where search_tag.content_id = c.id and position(#{query} in lower(search_tag.tag)) > 0 ) then 20 else 0 end + case when exists ( select 1 from content_recommend_words search_word where search_word.content_id = c.id and position(#{query} in lower(search_word.word)) > 0 ) then 10 else 0 end + case when exists ( select 1 from media_assets search_asset where search_asset.content_id = c.id and search_asset.kind = 'image' and c.type = 'image' and position(#{query} in lower(search_asset.url)) > 0 ) then 5 else 0 end ) as search_score
where c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and ( position(#{query} in lower(c.title)) > 0 or position(#{query} in lower(u.nickname)) > 0 or exists ( select 1 from content_tags filter_tag where filter_tag.content_id = c.id and position(#{query} in lower(filter_tag.tag)) > 0 ) or exists ( select 1 from content_recommend_words filter_word where filter_word.content_id = c.id and position(#{query} in lower(filter_word.word)) > 0 ) or exists ( select 1 from media_assets filter_asset where filter_asset.content_id = c.id and filter_asset.kind = 'image' and c.type = 'image' and position(#{query} in lower(filter_asset.url)) > 0 ) ) order by search_score desc, c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from content_items where id = #{id} and status = 'published' and visibility = 'public'

select
where c.author_user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.show_on_profile = true order by c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc

select
from follows f join content_items c on c.author_user_id = f.following_id join users u on u.id = c.author_user_id join content_stats s on s.content_id = c.id where f.follower_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' order by c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc

select
where c.author_user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published'
and c.visibility = 'public' and c.show_on_profile = true
order by case when c.profile_pinned_at is null then 1 else 0 end, c.profile_pinned_at desc, c.profile_sort_order desc, c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select
join content_likes profile_like on profile_like.content_id = c.id and profile_like.user_id = #{userId} where c.status = 'published'
and (c.visibility = 'public' or c.author_user_id = #{userId})
and c.visibility = 'public'
order by profile_like.created_at desc, c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select
join ( select ci.content_id, max(ci.created_at) as interacted_at from collections profile_collection join collection_items ci on ci.collection_id = profile_collection.id where profile_collection.user_id = #{userId} group by ci.content_id ) profile_favorite on profile_favorite.content_id = c.id where c.status = 'published'
and (c.visibility = 'public' or c.author_user_id = #{userId})
and c.visibility = 'public'
order by profile_favorite.interacted_at desc, c.publish_time desc, c.created_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from content_items c where c.author_user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 'published'
and c.visibility = 'public' and c.show_on_profile = true

and (c.visibility = 'public' or c.author_user_id = #{userId})
and c.visibility = 'public'

and (c.visibility = 'public' or c.author_user_id = #{userId})

mapper.insert: insert into content_items ( id, type, title, description, author_user_id, cover_url, status, visibility, publish_time ) values ( #{content.id}, #{content.type}, #{content.title}, #{content.description}, #{content.authorUserId}, #{content.coverUrl}, 'published', #{content.visibility}, #{content.publishTime} )

insert into content_tags (content_id, tag, sort_order) values
(#{contentId}, #{item.value}, #{item.sortOrder})

insert into content_recommend_words (content_id, word, sort_order) values
(#{contentId}, #{item.value}, #{item.sortOrder})

insert into media_assets (content_id, kind, url, sort_order) values
(#{asset.contentId}, #{asset.kind}, #{asset.url}, #{asset.sortOrder})
mapper.select: select tag from content_tags where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_order
select word from content_recommend_words where content_id = #{contentId} order by sort_order

select kind, quality, url, storage_key from media_assets where content_id = #{contentId} and kind = 'video' and delivery_type = 'hls' order by case when quality = 'auto' then 0 else 1 end, sort_order limit 1

select kind, quality, url, storage_key from media_assets where content_id = #{contentId} and kind = 'video' and quality is not null and coalesce(delivery_type, 'progressive') = 'progressive' order by sort_order
select kind, quality, url, storage_key from media_assets where content_id = #{contentId} and kind in ('image', 'video') order by sort_order
